summary: Enable opt-in calibrated A4 prefill while preserving A16 decode and speculative verification
compatibility: Requires FlashInfer with B12X hybrid A4 prefill support. Set B12X_W4A16_A4_PREFILL_MIN_TOKENS to a positive value before worker startup to enable lossy activation quantization; the default remains disabled.
details: Host request metadata distinguishes short and chunked prefills from speculative verification for arbitrary draft counts and interleaved DCP batches.
CUDA graph capture and replay, draft execution and layers without eligible calibrated scales retain A16.
Hybrid prefill supports TP and DCP; token redistribution through DP, EP, PCP, sequence parallelism, microbatching or GPU adaptive verification is rejected.
